perfil: A mysterious ninja who walks the night, wielding a long umbrella—its ribs as blades, its sleeves concealing deadly edges.

habilidades.b: Rapidly fires multiple kunai to deal DMG.

tpl.s: Rapidly fires multiple kunai. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto ATK DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto ATK DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto ATK DMG.

habilidades.b: Moves rapidly and shoots, dealing AoE DMG in a large area and triggering ⟨Umbra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Moves rapidly and shoots, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Umbra Skill DMG in a large area. Nightbloom (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Umbra Mark DMG and inflicting ⟨Dark Shackles⟩.

habilidades.b: Summons a forward-moving Weeping Sky that deals multi-hit AoE DMG. Weeping Sky can inflict Soul Rend to deal multi-hit single-target DMG. Both Weeping Sky and Soul Rend can inflict ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩.

tpl.s: Summons a forward-moving Weeping Sky, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG every 0.5s for 4s. Weeping Sky inflicts Soul Rend, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as single-target Umbra Skill DMG every 0.5s for 6s (does not stack). Inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ upon dealing DMG with Weeping Sky or Soul Rend.

habilidades.b: Throws and detonates a parasol, dealing multi-hit DMG in a large area.

tpl.s: Throws a parasol that spins, which deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Umbra Ultimate DMG. Then, detonates the parasol, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK, ⟦2⟧ of ATK, and ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Umbra Ultimate DMG in a large area.

builds.d: A build that reduces Ultimate cooldown, enabling frequent Ultimate use.
A build that increases stack count and hit frequency to boost Skill DMG.

l.b: When shooting with Nightbloom (Main Skill), summons Doomfall multiple times. Can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. Upon summoning Doomfall, reduces Ultimate Cooldown and gains Energy.
l.s: When shooting with Nightbloom (Main Skill), it summons Doomfall ⟦0⟧ times, each dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG, and triggering ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. Upon summoning Doomfall, reduces Ultimate Cooldown by ⟦2⟧s and gains ⟦3⟧ Energy. This effect can only be triggered once every 1s.

l.b: Moving with Nightbloom (Main Skill) knocks back nearby targets and gains a Shield. While the Shield lasts, continuously gains Energy and summons Doomfall.
l.s: Moving with Nightbloom (Main Skill) knocks back nearby targets and gains a Shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of Base Max HP for ⟦1⟧s. While the Shield lasts, gains ⟦2⟧ Energy every 1s and summons Doomfall, each dealing ⟦3⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG.

l.b: Dealing Auto Attack DMG summons Doomfall.
l.s: Upon dealing Auto Attack DMG 5 times, summons Doomfall to deal ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 2s.

l.b: Otoha's Auto Attack increases Auto Attack DMG and Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Otoha's Auto Attack increases Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ and Ultimate DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: When casting Nightbloom (Main Skill), increases Otoha's ATK SPD.
l.s: When casting Nightbloom (Main Skill), increases Otoha's ATK SPD by ⟦0⟧ and Umbra DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 8s.

l.b: Bullets fired with Nightbloom (Main Skill) can ricochet multiple additional times.
l.s: Bullets fired with Nightbloom (Main Skill) can ricochet ⟦0⟧ more times.

l.b: The explosion of bullets fired with Nightbloom (Main Skill) can generate multiple small bullets.
l.s: The explosion of bullets fired with Nightbloom (Main Skill) generates 8 small bullets, each dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG.

l.b: Increases the uses of Nightbloom (Main Skill). When casting the Main Skill, increases Otoha's Umbra DMG.
l.s: Increases the uses of Nightbloom (Main Skill) by 1. When casting the Main Skill, increases Otoha's Umbra DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 2 times.

l.b: Increases Skill DMG dealt by Nightbloom (Main Skill) against targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩.
l.s: Increases Skill DMG dealt by Nightbloom (Main Skill) against targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Immune to DMG while moving during Nightbloom (Main Skill). Increases Otoha's ATK.
l.s: Immune to DMG while moving during Nightbloom (Main Skill). Increases Otoha's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Otoha triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases her Umbra DMG.
l.s: When Otoha triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases her Umbra DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 4s, stacking up to 2 times.

l.b: Increases Otoha's dodges. When dodging, increases her ATK.
l.s: Otoha can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 4s.

l.b: Void Blossom (Ultimate) triggers ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. Increases Otoha's ATK.
l.s: Void Blossom (Ultimate) triggers ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. Increases Otoha's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The parasol thrown by Void Blossom (Ultimate) pulls in nearby targets. Increases Otoha's Umbra DMG.
l.s: The parasol thrown by Void Blossom (Ultimate) pulls in nearby targets. Increases Otoha's Umbra DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Void Blossom (Ultimate) to targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Void Blossom (Ultimate) to targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases ATK when Otoha casts Void Blossom (Ultimate).
l.s: Increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 30s when Otoha casts Void Blossom (Ultimate).

builds.d: A build that combines sustained Support DMG with frequent Ultimate use.
A Skill-focused build centered on high burst DMG and concentrated attacks.

l.b: Increases Soul Rend duration. When Otoha deals Ultimate DMG, reduces Ultimate Cooldown and gains Energy. Increases Otoha's Ultimate DMG and Ultimate Crit Rate.
l.s: Increases Soul Rend duration to ⟦0⟧s. When Otoha deals Ultimate DMG, reduces Ultimate Cooldown by ⟦1⟧s and gain ⟦2⟧ Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 1s. Increases Otoha's Ultimate DMG by ⟦3⟧ and Ultimate Crit Rate by ⟦4⟧.

l.b: When the Main Umbra Trekker deals DMG to a target with Soul Rend, Otoha summons Doomfall, dealing AoE DMG and gaining Energy. Increases Otoha's Ultimate DMG and Ultimate Crit Rate.
l.s: When the Main Umbra Trekker deals DMG to a target with Soul Rend, Otoha summons Doomfall, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG and gaining ⟦1⟧ Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 1s. Increases Otoha's Ultimate DMG by ⟦2⟧ and Ultimate Crit Rate by ⟦3⟧.

l.b: When Otoha deals Ultimate DMG, there is a chance to shoot multiple times. Increases Otoha's Ultimate Crit Rate.
l.s: When Otoha deals Ultimate DMG, there is a 80% chance to shoot 3 times, each dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 2s. Increases Otoha's Ultimate Crit Rate by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Shattered Edge (Support Skill) is on cooldown, increases Otoha's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Shattered Edge (Support Skill) is on cooldown, increases Otoha's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When any Umbra Trekker casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Otoha's Ultimate Crit Rate and Ultimate Crit DMG.
l.s: When any Umbra Trekker casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Otoha's Ultimate Crit Rate by ⟦0⟧ and Ultimate Crit DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 6.5s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: When Weeping Sky advances, summons additional bombardments to deal AoE DMG. Bombardments have a chance to deal DMG multiple times. Increases DEF PEN dealt by Weeping Sky. Increases Otoha's Skill DMG.

Each bombardment generated during this skill increases this chance by ⟦4⟧. Increases DEF PEN dealt by Weeping Sky by ⟦5⟧. Increases Otoha's Skill DMG by ⟦6⟧.

l.b: In an all-Umbra squad, summons additional Weeping Sky. Increases DEF PEN dealt by Weeping Sky to targets inflicted with ⟨Umbra Mark⟩ or ⟨Dark Shackles⟩. Increases Otoha's Skill DMG.
l.s: In an all-Umbra squad, summons ⟦0⟧ additional wave of Weeping Sky, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG. Increases DEF PEN dealt by Weeping Sky to targets inflicted with ⟨Umbra Mark⟩ or ⟨Dark Shackles⟩ by ⟦2⟧. Increases Otoha's Skill DMG by ⟦3⟧.

l.s: Reduces the forward movement speed of Weeping Sky by ⟦0⟧ and increases its Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases Weeping Sky's Umbra DMG against elite or higher-tier targets.
l.s: Increases Weeping Sky's Umbra DMG against elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Weeping Sky deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.

l.s: Each Umbra Trekker in the squad increases all Umbra teammates' Umbra DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Void Blossom (Ultimate) to targets inflicted with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩ by ⟦0⟧.
